summary.business_type: Local multi-service company (IT services, consultancy, trade, logistics, education) — hybrid local + global service business
top_findings: CRITICAL (FIXED during audit): canonical URLs and og:image pointed to http://localhost:3000 on every page — rebuilt and redeployed mid-audit; now correct
No llms.txt — AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) have no curated site map for citations
Blog depth thin: 6 posts averaging ~400 words from a 2,420-word data file — below the 800–1,200 competitive floor for B2B keywords
Only 9 unique internal links on the homepage — weak link equity distribution to blog and case studies
sitemap.xml lacks lastmod dates; 27 URLs listed vs 22 public pages found — some URLs may be stale
quick_wins: Add llms.txt and allow AI crawlers in robots.txt (30 min)
Convert remaining JPG images to WebP (hero-bg.jpg 116KB, import-export.jpg 100KB)
Add 3–5 internal links from homepage to blog/case studies
Expand two weakest blog posts to 800+ words with FAQ sections

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean robots.txt with proper private-area disallows (/portal, /admin, /api, /auth)
sitemap.xml present with 27 URLs including all blog posts and case studies
Excellent security headers: CSP, HSTS (1yr, includeSubDomains), X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff
CDN-served (hcdn), HTTPS enforced with upgrade-insecure-requests
Static export = inherently fast TTFB (~0.31s from CDN)

findings.title: Canonical URLs pointed to localhost (FIXED during audit)
findings.description: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL was http://localhost:3000, so every page emitted <link rel=canonical href=http://localhost:3000/...> and og:image on localhost. Google consolidates signals toward the declared canonical — this can suppress indexing of the real domain.
findings.recommendation: Fixed: env set to https://lakshyagroups.in, rebuilt, redeployed, verified live. Monitor GSC indexing over the next 2 weeks.

findings.title: Sitemap lacks lastmod dates
findings.description: sitemap.xml lists 27 URLs but no <lastmod>, so Google cannot prioritize recrawls of changed content.
findings.recommendation: Emit lastmod from post/page updatedAt fields in the sitemap generator.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Consistent E-E-A-T signals: named founder, real Bengaluru address, concrete service pages
Case studies with quantified outcomes (12 developers upskilled, 4 vendors consolidated)
Clear, jargon-free copy with strong readability

findings.title: Blog posts are thin
findings.description: 6 posts sharing ~2,420 words total (~400 words each). Competing B2B content for these keywords runs 800–1,500 words. Thin content limits ranking and AI-citation potential.
findings.recommendation: Expand top 3 posts to 900–1,200 words: add original examples, pricing frameworks, comparison tables, and FAQ sections (FAQ sections also enable rich results).

findings.title: Only 9 unique internal links from homepage
findings.description: The homepage links to main sections but barely to blog posts or case studies, so those pages receive little link equity and crawl priority.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Latest writing' and 'Client results' section on the homepage linking to 3 blog posts + 3 case studies.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 per page across all sampled pages
Healthy heading pyramid (1 h1, 8 h2, 21 h3 on home)
Unique, keyword-rich titles within length limits on all pages (post-fix: no duplicated brand suffix)
Meta descriptions present and specific on all sampled pages
Canonicals now correct on every page

findings.title: Titles had doubled brand suffix (FIXED earlier today)
findings.description: 12 pages baked '| Lakshya Groups | Bengaluru' into their title while the layout template appended it again. Fixed with title.absolute on all 12 pages; verified live.
findings.recommendation: No further action; keep pattern for future pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Rich implementation: Organization, LocalBusiness, WebSite+SearchAction, BreadcrumbList on key pages
Service pages carry Service + OfferCatalog + Offer markup
FAQ page has FAQPage schema
Person schema for the founder

findings.title: No Article schema on blog posts
findings.description: Blog posts lack Article/BlogPosting JSON-LD with author, datePublished, headline — losing rich-result eligibility and AI-citation clarity.
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting schema to the blog [slug] template with author, dates, and image.

findings.title: No AggregateRating/Review signals
findings.description: Testimonials exist visually but carry no Review/AggregateRating schema (correctly not faked — but real reviews could be marked up once collected).
findings.recommendation: Collect 5+ verifiable client reviews, then add Review schema.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: TTFB 0.31–0.46s from CDN across sampled pages (excellent)
Total HTML weight 44–75KB — lean pages
Static export, minimal client JS for a marketing site
Founder image optimized to WebP 44KB during this session

findings.title: hero-bg.jpg still 116KB JPG
findings.description: Largest image on the site; likely LCP element on mobile home. WebP would cut it to ~50KB.
findings.recommendation: Convert hero-bg.jpg (and import-export.jpg 100KB) to WebP at quality 82.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Clean semantic HTML, single-H1 structure, descriptive headings — good passage extraction
FAQ page with matching FAQPage schema — citable format
Concrete numbers throughout (63 countries, 7 services) — strong citation hooks

findings.title: No llms.txt and no AI-crawler policy
findings.description: llms.txt returns 404. robots.txt does not explicitly allow GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot. AI engines may under-cite the site.
findings.recommendation: Add llms.txt summarizing the business, services, and key pages; explicitly allow AI user-agents in robots.txt.

findings.title: Thin blog reduces citability
findings.description: AI systems favor comprehensive pages when choosing citation sources; 400-word posts rarely win citations.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as content depth — expand posts with data, tables, and FAQs.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Zero img tags missing alt text (14/14 have alt)
Modern formats partially adopted (WebP for founder, og-image)
Reasonable file sizes overall

findings.title: Two heavy JPGs remain
findings.description: hero-bg.jpg (116KB) and import-export.jpg (100KB) still serve as JPG despite WebP usage elsewhere.
findings.recommendation: Convert both to WebP (~60% size cut) and update references.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: DONE: canonical/og:url fix deployed — monitor GSC 'Pages' report for 2 weeks for indexing recovery
Request re-indexing of 5 key pages in Google Search Console
Add llms.txt + explicit AI-crawler allows in robots.txt

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand 3 blog posts to 900-1,200 words with FAQ sections
Add BlogPosting schema to blog template
Add homepage sections linking to blog + case studies (internal links)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish 2 new in-depth posts targeting customer questions
Collect and markup 5+ real client reviews
Convert remaining JPGs to WebP; add sitemap lastmod

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up GSC + GA4 monthly review
Re-run this audit monthly (scripts/responsive-audit.mjs + this checklist)
Track AI-citation presence in Perplexity/ChatGPT for 'web development company Bengaluru'
